name: writing
description: 26 skills in four layers — general dramaturgy (project workflow & story bible, story structure, premise & theme, character & conflict psychology, dialogue, scene craft, format & adaptation, Truby organic story anatomy and genre anatomy), the medium layer (series: episode & season structure, series engine & bible, writers' room, half-hour comedy; stage: Chinese opera, banqiang and qupai methods with two full-script case libraries), tradition & trade (American case studies, Japanese method, Korean & French method, mainland-Chinese series practice and production chain, industry & business), and master corpora (Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style, Succession ensemble writing, television case studies) — distilled from 47 books and 23 volumes of published scripts and opera scores — Output language follows the user's question, not the Chinese skill bodies; craft terms are anchored to their original English via sw-workflow/terms.md.
